A GUARDIAN’S GUIDE

Seven shrines. One sacred duty.

Stop the army before it reaches the temple. A commander reaching the sanctuary breaks the shield completely. Tap a numbered plot, choose a deity, then begin the wave.

Offerings & favour

Offerings are the only currency. Spend them to establish a shrine or raise its divine favour: Established → Honoured → Exalted. Favour is a level, not a second balance. Rebuilding returns 85% of your investment.

Divine protection

A shield emblem marks a protected foe. Tap the foe to see “Protected by…” and its current effects. That shrine will not harm them. Build a mixed defence and inspect the next wave before starting.

Useful combinations

Agni: sustained fire; build early along the path.
Indra: chain attacks; Varuna’s water improves conduction.
Varuna: light damage, one washback with four-second resistance, and a Wet mark.
Vayu: powerful immediate damage.
Prithvi: rolling boulders and armour cracking.
Saraswati: reveals and quickens; no damage.
Durga: select a shrine, then a foe for a powerful manual strike.

Divine intervention

Defending fills one shared meter. At 100%, select an established shrine and call its intervention during a wave. Choose the deity carefully. Aiming pauses time. Vayu and Prithvi show the chosen area before confirmation (left/right arrows also choose path bends). Durga readies a manually targeted strike. During Raktabija’s appearance, the regional action becomes Call Kali.

Waves and battles

A wave is a group of enemies. A battle is one complete encounter at a temple, lasting four to eight waves. Shrines and upgrades stay between waves; a new battle starts afresh.

Extra offerings

Once all foes in a wave have arrived, call the next wave early for bonus offerings. Two waves overlap, so be ready for the extra pressure.

Restoration and lamps

Win to restore the temple. Earn three lamps for victory, an intact shield and the map’s challenge, across separate attempts. All three unlock festival decorations.

Follow the river

Travel with Mira from the banyan grove to the river’s source. Each region has three connected encounters. Defeat its commander to restore the temple. All encounters are open for testing.

Pause to plan, build or upgrade. Choose 1×, 2× or 5× speed. Enemy introductions always pause combat. Progress saves on this browser; an interrupted battle resumes paused. All seven shrines and all five temples are available in this prototype. This is an original journey drawing together stories from different traditions, not a chronological retelling. The alliance and motives of Vritra, Mahishasura and Raktabija are inventions for this game. The temples are community refuges and maintain the river’s sacred protections; they have no separate deity powers. Durga confronts Mahishasura, Kali counters Raktabija’s multiplying blood, and Indra frees waters bound by Vritra. Shields, cooldowns and magical seeds are invented game rules. Naga and vanara conflicts concern particular groups, not entire peoples.
